# v0.10.3 - Fixes Found by a Wider Differential Fuzz

## What's Changed in v0.10.3

A fixes-only release (maintenance mode): four snapshot defects found by widening the differential fuzz (random changes to a tree, then comparing what the same vault records with what a new vault records), a payload upload fix, and one more warn-first pass of the deprecation policy. Each fix has a test that fails without it.

### Fixed
- **Snapshots**: a link replaced by a regular file is recorded as a file when git has no symlink support (`core.symlinks` false: a Windows git without the privilege, a FAT volume); before, it could be recorded as a link whose target was the file's bytes. A file replaced by a repository under a different case of its name is no longer captured twice. A tracked file replaced by a folder that holds a repository with no commit no longer stops every later snapshot.
- **Payload upload**: a damaged copy another writer had already deleted no longer strands the whole copy as `<sha> (1)`.

### Deprecated
- **A snapshot run with `--no-push` now prints a `Warning:`** for `--payload-jobs`, `--payload-auto-ratio`, `--payload-skip-changing` and `--payload-rehash`, which only tune an upload it does not make; they are refused from 0.11, as the options of 0.10.1. A job with `--exit-warnings` that passes one exits `3` until it is dropped. See "Options by mode" in `SNAPSHOT.md`.

### Upgrading

Nothing about what is stored changes and no setting is renamed. See "Upgrading to v0.10.3" in `UPGRADING.md`.

The full list is in `CHANGELOG.md`.
